snippet.title: Let's Sing ABBA | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Celebrate the 50th anniversary of Dancing Queen and the great return of ABBA. Choose from a collection of 32(*) ABBA classics and perform them in 7 different game modes.
Turn your living room into a stage, let the lights find you with Let's Sing ABBA.
 
(*) The PlayStation 5, Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2 releases of Let's Sing ABBA all include the additional song "I Have A Dream".
